title: Standardized structured emergency call taking
summary:
In Germany, emergency care is being used more and more often. This can lead to overload and delays in urgent emergency care. One key focus of the planned emergency reform is therefore improving how patients are directed. For this, better cooperation among everyone involved in acute and emergency care is crucial. Specifically, emergencies should be identified as quickly and safely as possible, while less urgent cases shouldn’t tie up unnecessary medical and rescue resources.
To be able to implement targeted and structured management in emergency situations, reliable, structured and evidence-based criteria for decision-making are necessary. Currently, different types of queries are used in service and emergency dispatch centers. A structured standard query could not only make care in emergencies more efficient but also improve patient safety. The aim of the project is therefore to develop and test a questionnaire for structured emergency call  taking and management for the emergency numbers 112 and 116117.
For this, researchers want to develop a reference guide for structured emergency call taking. To do this, available studies and guidelines will be analyzed and evaluated. Based on data from emergency dispatching centers and health insurance companies, care issues will be identified. The recommendations developed from this will then be turned into a questionnaire. During the evaluation, the questionnaire´s suitablity and understandability for users (dispatchers at control centers) will be assessed. Additionally, a comprehension test will be conducted, involving medical laypeople (callers, citizens).
In case successful, the developed list of questions can be used in emergency care to improve appointment service centers and emergency dispatching centers working together more effectively. The questions identified can also help in the future to evaluate existing emergency dispatching software for their suitability or improve them.
conditions: 112/116117 call taking reasons with acute/urgent and emergency concerns
